## Services (dedicated pages)

- [Social Media Marketing](https://portfolio.riajultech.com/services/social-media-marketing): organic social media management, content strategy & monthly calendars, Facebook & Instagram management, Meta Ads, retargeting, A/B testing, GA4/GTM tracking, monthly reporting — 26 capabilities in 7 groups.
- [Meta Ads Management](https://portfolio.riajultech.com/services/meta-ads): Pixel + Conversions API, funnel-structured campaigns, custom/lookalike/retargeting audiences, creative testing, scaling, reporting.
- [Google Ads Management](https://portfolio.riajultech.com/services/google-ads): Search, Shopping and Performance Max, keyword & match type strategy, negative keywords, RSA copy, bidding strategy, conversion tracking.
- [Search Engine Optimization](https://portfolio.riajultech.com/services/seo): technical audits, keyword & intent research, topic clusters, on-page optimization, internal linking, Search Console-led iteration.
- [Analytics & Tracking](https://portfolio.riajultech.com/services/analytics): GA4 setup, Google Tag Manager, event tracking plans, Meta Pixel & CAPI, UTM conventions, Looker Studio dashboards.
- [Conversion Rate Optimization](https://portfolio.riajultech.com/services/cro): landing page & funnel audits, heatmap/session review, hypothesis-driven A/B testing, form/CTA/offer optimization.
